law.authorized_strength_capability_ceiling: At full headcount refill r_m=ell, C_infinity/C_0=1-ell*(1-q)<1 whenever E_R<E.
law.finite_refill_condition: A one-time intake cohort can reach nominal headcount in finite time only when n*b>ell.

synthetic_implications: Training throughput and reserve survival determine how quickly a force can refill authorized personnel, but authorized-strength capping prevents indefinite absorption into a fully refilled formation.
When replacements are less experienced than incumbents, restoring nominal headcount does not restore the original modeled combat capability.

A one-time recruit intake exactly equal to personnel losses cannot produce finite-time full headcount recovery if trained-reserve attrition is positive; intake must exceed the loss fraction after reserve survival.
Faster training can shorten the time to headcount recovery but cannot remove the veterancy-limited capability ceiling created by lower-experience replacements.
claim_boundary: SL11 is an exact composite theorem of Pineland's synthetic training, reserve, target-strength, replacement-memory, and combat-capability equations. It is not an empirical force-generation or replacement-policy law.
